target_pages.complexity_reason: Full-width figure/caption above two independent text columns, footnotes at both column bottoms, a wrapped code URL, and continuation across page/column boundaries create a high-value native reading-order stress page.
target_pages.acceptance_on_lambda: This case is accepted only if the governing deterministic layout opener actually fires on the authoritative downloaded PDF. Required checks include duplicate-block ratio, interleaved/overlapping column order, and native-vs-structure token/order metrics.
target_pages.if_opener_does_not_fire: Reject this source as the malformed-layout case before model benchmarking; do not lower thresholds or invoke a VLM. Replace it with another source case and make that replacement durable first.

target_pages.complexity_reason: Wide figure spans the page above dense two-column text with footnotes/equations and image labels; audit as a secondary candidate only if page 1 does not open.
target_pages.acceptance_on_lambda: Same oracle-free deterministic opener as the governing contract.

native_audit_requirements: authoritative PDF SHA-256 and exact page count
standard_no_ocr structure block order and bboxes
human-checked expected reading order only after the production opener fires

replacement_policy.action_if_no_target_page_opens: Select a replacement complex born-digital/hybrid PDF and merge an updated case manifest before any layout candidate benchmark.

authority_and_transport: Original downloaded arXiv PDF is benchmark authority after SHA-256 capture.
Public web parse/screenshots only justify source selection; they do not establish a production layout anomaly.
PDF bytes stay outside Git; Git retains source locator, later hash, opener diagnostics, and compact annotations.
model_gate: Source audit passed with both registered layout targets opening; bounded model prefetch may proceed, but model inference remains closed until the separate prefetch/license/checksum gate passes.
